manifest before it ships

observations.why: Mandating a signed manifest before shipping appeals to security/stability (conservation) and quality-of-craft control (competence).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifying the gate by past unsigned artifacts frames security as the appealed-to good.
Restating the gate as a bolded directive reinforces the security-and-control value move.
Extending the gate's scope to all deploy environments appeals to comprehensive security coverage.
Claiming named ownership of the gate appeals to standing and accountability as the good.
